meta_description:
60K likes, 762 comments - aarzoo_khurana on May 24, 2024: "Having lived a dream come true today, I am at a loss for words to describe the experience of meeting Sh. Ratan Tata Sir — a man of unmatched finesse, poise and, above all, humility. The towering great generations have looked up to was so kind and humble as to walk us to the door after an incisive interaction. 

So let me stop letting words repeatedly fail to do justice to the experience and just say this: Sir, you are a hero to all of us, and this picture with you is among my most prized possessions.

#dreamcometrue #aarzookhuranaphotography #aarzookhurana #ratantatasir #photooftheera #dreams #idol #happiness".
